commit_sha_note: The final branch-tip SHA is resolved after RETURN.json is committed and reported in the governed handoff; a Git commit cannot self-embed its own resulting SHA.
headline_findings: Validated C11 is the earliest common carrier-neutral logical interface, not the full A/B/C comparison terminal.
I03 exact empirical facts are mandatory intermediate outputs, but stopping at I03 omits the separately owned exact-bounded discovery/learned workload.

The lawful first common pre-Field-Forge comparison terminal is the governed I05 learned empirical product with exact product, semantic, replay and output identities plus coverage/constituent-fact closure.
Cold/warm, deletion/regeneration, invalidation, audit and fresh-process replay belong to the wider physical-cost measurement envelope and must preserve or reproduce the same semantic terminal.

Candidate-neutral semantic authority and candidate-owned realization cost are separate; common upstream truth must not be reminted per candidate, and candidate-specific I03/I05/physical realization must not be pre-solved for one candidate.
Structural admission, pressure synthesis, temporalization and Field Forge execution remain downstream of the P2 terminal.
